source: Advisor meeting 2026-09-18: first inspect Stage-1 convergence, freeze one reviewed epoch, rerun Level 3 at that epoch with original damping, and only then inspect smaller damping.

steps.exactness: Original epoch-25/50 parameters, Adam state and CPU/CUDA RNG plus final epoch-50 model/RNG must match. Source, input and dataset fingerprints must remain unchanged.
steps.selection_policy: No automatic plateau label or suggested E*. The team reviews all five curves and freezes exactly one saved checkpoint in frozen_E_star.json.

steps.truth_replay: At original epoch 50, verify every target/fixed/baseline/no-op/LOO endpoint against the frozen condition. Deterministically regenerate native Adam state and continue the same in-memory optimizer to E*. Baseline/no-op E* anchors must match Step-1 frozen checkpoints.
steps.comparison: Require identical seed/patient/class keys and compare on the same gate-passing cell intersection at 50 and E*. gamma=0.01 is E*-only because the frozen E50 sweep did not contain it.
steps.a2_gate: Damping submission requires an immutable approval record hashing the A1 comparison and truth-preflight artifacts.
steps.new_anchor_only: All results live under a timestamped oct2-pathway2-runs/A/l3_at_E... attempt; no original truth is overwritten or replaced.

forbidden_conclusions: A flat online loss alone proves the Eq. 56 stationarity premise
An E* result replaces or validates the original 50-epoch truth
A smaller damping is better without matched qualified coverage and residual checks
No improvement at one E* rules out every static influence method
